title: Prefabricated small unit for relocation: building consent required (Sefton, Canterbury)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
code_edition: Building Act ss 7, 8, 41 and Schedule 1 clause 43 as cited
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: Owner of a property at Sefton: a small unit prefabricated off-site and intended to be moved to another site; authority proposed to require building consent.
Determination discusses the Building Act definitions of 'building' and 'building work' and the Schedule 1 clause 43 exemption.
Footnote 43 notes the 2021 amendment inserting s41(1)(f) for modular components made by a registered manufacturer; regulations supporting the scheme were made on 7 June 2022.
Decision: building consent required for the prefabrication of the unit at the applicant's property; authority's proposed exercise of its power confirmed (31 August 2022).
